name: Fantasy
summary: Fantasy is a literary genre set in imagined worlds, drawing inspiration from mythology and folklore.
description: Fantasy is a literary genre set in imagined worlds, drawing inspiration from mythology and folklore. Originating in oral traditions, it evolved into written literature and dramatic works. The genre is commonly associated with epic high fantasy, often featuring medieval European influences. However, fantasy encompasses diverse settings and styles, including both high and low fantasy.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Adventure, creativity, ambition, companionship, freespirit
